title: Login with valid credentials shows welcome

steps.naturalLanguage: On the Login screen, tap the username field
Type the QA username into the username field
Type the QA password into the password field
Verify the welcome banner shows 'Welcome, QA User'

_reviewerNote: No traditional locators (accessibility-id, xpath). Perfecto's semantic+visual matching resolves 'field labeled Username on screen Login' internally — the resolution logic is vendor-proprietary and not inspectable. This is the black-box: the bank cannot see HOW a natural-language step maps to an element, only THAT it did. Compare O1/O3 where resolvedLocators carry confidence + source and are auditable. The export below (ExportedAppiumTest.js) is the rel-26.2 escape hatch that re-materializes this into inspectable code.
